description_en: Queries Resource Access Management (RAM) user provisioning events
description_zh: 调用ListUserProvisioningEvents查询执行失败的RAM用户同步事件列表
name: ListUserProvisioningEvents

parameters.help_en: The ID of the RAM user provisioning
parameters.name: user_provisioning_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource directory
parameters.name: directory_id

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页的最大数据条数。

取值范围：1~100。

默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used to initiate the next request. If this is your first time to call this operation, you do not need to specify the `NextToken` parameter.

When you call this operation for the first time, if the total number of entries to return is larger than the value of `MaxResults`, the entries are truncated. The system returns entries based on the value of `MaxResults`, and does not return the excess entries. In this case, the value of the response parameter `IsTruncated` is `true`, and `NextToken` is returned. In the next call, you can use the value of `NextToken` and maintain the settings of the other request parameters to query the excess entries. You can repeat the call until the value of `IsTruncated` becomes `false`. This way, all entries are returned
parameters.help_zh:
查询返回结果下一页的令牌。首次调用API不需要`NextToken`。

当您首次调用API时，如果返回数据总条数超过`MaxResults`限制，数据会被截断，只返回`MaxResults`条数据，同时，返回参数`IsTruncated`为`true`，返回一个`NextToken`。您可以使用上一次返回的`NextToken`继续调用API，其他请求参数保持不变，查询被截断的数据。您可以按此方法多次查询，直到`IsTruncated`为`false`，表示全部数据查询完毕
parameters.name: next_token

IsTruncated.description_en:
Indicates whether the queried entries are truncated. Valid values:

true

false
IsTruncated.description_zh:
返回结果是否被截断。取值：

true：已截断。
false：未截断

MaxResults.description_en:
The maximum number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10
MaxResults.description_zh:
每页的最大数据条数。

取值范围：1~100。

默认值：10

NextToken.description_en:
The token that is used to initiate the next request.

This parameter is returned only when the `IsTruncated` parameter is set to `true`
NextToken.description_zh:
查询返回结果下一页的令牌。 

只有`IsTruncated`为`true`时，才显示该参数

TotalCounts.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCounts.description_zh: 符合请求参数条件的数据总条数

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time. The time is displayed in UTC

DeletionStrategy.description_en:
The deletion policy. The policy is used to manage synchronized users when you delete the RAM user provisioning. Valid values:

Delete: When you delete the RAM user provisioning, the system deletes the synchronized users.

Keep: When you delete the RAM user provisioning, the system retains the synchronized users
DeletionStrategy.description_zh:
删除策略。删除RAM用户同步时，对已同步的RAM用户的处理策略。取值：

Delete：删除。删除RAM用户同步时，会删除从云SSO已经同步到RAM中的RAM用户。
Keep：保留。删除RAM用户同步时，会保留从云SSO已经同步到RAM中的RAM用户

DirectoryId.description_en: The ID of the resource directory

DuplicationStrategy.description_en:
The conflict handling policy. The policy is used when a RAM user has the same username as the CloudSSO user who is synchronized to RAM. Valid values:

KeepBoth: When a CloudSSO user is synchronized to RAM, if a RAM user who has the same username as the CloudSSO user exists, the system creates a RAM user whose username is the username of the CloudSSO user plus the suffix `_sso`.

TakeOver: When a CloudSSO user is synchronized to RAM, if a RAM user who has the same username as the CloudSSO user exists, the system replaces the RAM user with the CloudSSO user
DuplicationStrategy.description_zh:
冲突策略。当云SSO用户同步到RAM时，如果RAM中存在同名用户时的处理策略。取值：

KeepBoth：两者都保留。当云SSO用户被同步到RAM时，如果RAM已经存在同名用户，则对云SSO用户的用户名添加后缀`_sso`后尝试创建该用户名的RAM用户。
TakeOver：替换。当云SSO用户被同步到RAM时，如果RAM已经存在同名用户，则直接将已经存在的RAM用户替换为云SSO同步用户

ErrorInfo.description_en: The error message that is displayed when the last execution of the RAM user provisioning event failed
ErrorInfo.description_zh: RAM用户同步事件上次执行失败的错误信息

EventId.description_en: The ID of the RAM user provisioning event

LatestAsyncTime.description_en: The time at which the RAM user provisioning event was last executed. The time is displayed in UTC
LatestAsyncTime.description_zh: 此事件上次执行的时间（UTC时间）

PrincipalId.description_en:
The identity ID of the RAM user provisioning. Valid values:

If you set the `PrincipalType` parameter to `Group`, the value of this parameter is the ID of a CloudSSO user group (g-\\\\).

If you set the `PrincipalType` parameter to `User`, the value of this parameter is the ID of a CloudSSO user (u-\\\\)
PrincipalId.description_zh:
RAM用户同步的身份ID。取值：

当`PrincipalType`取值为`Group`时，该值为云SSO用户组ID（g-\\\\）。
当`PrincipalType`取值为`User`时，该值为云SSO用户ID（u-\\\\）

PrincipalName.description_en:
The identity name of the RAM user provisioning. Valid values:

If `Group` is returned for the `PrincipalType` parameter, the value of this parameter is the name of a CloudSSO user group.

If `User` is returned for the `PrincipalType` parameter, the value of this parameter is the name of a CloudSSO user
PrincipalName.description_zh:
RAM用户同步的身份名称。取值：

当`PrincipalType`取值为`Group`时，该值为云SSO用户组名称。
当`PrincipalType`取值为`User`时，该值为云SSO用户名称

PrincipalType.description_en:
The identity type of the RAM user provisioning. Valid values:

User: The identity of the RAM user provisioning is a CloudSSO user.

Group: The identity of the RAM user provisioning is a CloudSSO user group
PrincipalType.description_zh:
RAM用户同步的身份类型。取值：
User：表示该RAM用户同步的身份是云SSO用户。
Group：表示该RAM用户同步的身份是云SSO用户组

SourceType.description_en:
The type of the source operation. Valid values:

StartProvisioning: enables the RAM user provisioning.

DeleteProvisioning: deletes the RAM user provisioning.

AddUserToGroup: adds a user to a user group.

RemoveUserFromGroup: removes a user from a user group.

UserProvisioningDeletionClearing: deletes the RAM user provisioning and clears resources in the background
SourceType.description_zh:
源操作类型。取值：
StartProvisioning：启用RAM用户同步。
DeleteProvisioning：删除RAM用户同步。
AddUserToGroup：用户加入用户组。
RemoveUserFromGroup：用户从用户组移出。
UserProvisioningDeletionClearing：删除RAM用户同步之后，后台进行资源清理

TargetId.description_en:
The ID of the object for which you create the RAM user provisioning.

The value is fixed as the ID of the account in the resource directory.\`\`\`\`
TargetId.description_zh:
RAM用户同步的目标ID。

当`TargetType`为`RD-Account`时，取值为RD账号ID

TargetName.description_en:
The name of the object for which you create the RAM user provisioning.

If `RD-Account` is returned, the value of this parameter is the name of the account that is used to access the instance.\`\`
TargetName.description_zh:
RAM用户同步的目标名称。

当`TargetType`为`RD-Account`时，取值为RD 账号名称

TargetPath.description_en: The path of the resource directory in which you create the RAM user provisioning for the member
TargetPath.description_zh: RAM用户同步的目标的RD路径

TargetType.description_en: The object for which you create the RAM user provisioning. The value is fixed as `RD-Account`
TargetType.description_zh: RAM用户同步的目标类型。目前取值为`RD-Account`

UpdateTime.description_en: The modification time. The time is displayed in UTC

UserProvisioningId.description_en: The ID of the RAM user provisioning
